verdict.rationale: The only source-related evidence is a public GitHub repo for Together's TypeScript client SDK (togethercomputer/together-typescript), which lets users read the client library's code. Nothing shows the hosted inference and training platform itself is source-available, and no open license is stated for the SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g., Apache/MIT) on any repo, source availability for the core platform rather than just the client SDK, and independent corroboration.
